description: A palm-sized wedge of warm ceramic that isn't quite any color. A single unlabeled stud sits under your thumb. You have no idea what it is, and yet your thumb already knows the weight of pressing it. A hairline seam runs around its middle, as if it is only ever meant to be used once.
name: X-90 Sequence Holocaster

tags.description: A palm-sized wedge of warm ceramic that isn't quite any color. One stud, one seam, one use.
